newsitem.title: USA: America Online, 1-800-FLOWERS in online pact.
newsitem.headline: America Online, 1-800-FLOWERS in online pact.

text.p: America Online Inc on Tuesday said it entered into an online commerce pact with 1-800-FLOWERS, under which the florist will remain the exclusive seller of floral and plant products on the online service.
AOL said 1-800-FLOWERS has held this position since 1994.
1-800-FLOWERS expects to generate over $250 million in cumulative sales through the partnership over the four-year term of the agreement.

AOL said it will will receive payments totaling $25 million plus a limited revenue share. The revenue share would result in significant additional amounts to AOL based upon cumulative sales upward of $200 million, it said.
Both partners commit significant marketing, promotional and advertising efforts to the partnership, with 1-800-FLOWERS also providing subscriber acquisition assistance on behalf of AOL, it said.
1-800-FLOWERS will also provide AOL members with a variety of exclusive special offers, AOL said.
